maya (design): Pushing a tiny PR mock — thinking about two things: (1) show schema validation inline in the function-def panel instead of a top banner, and (2) introduce a compact tool-card in run history that collapses the tool output to one line we can expand. link: https://mock.redwood/playground/compact ethan (devex): Inline errors sound great. Question: do we show the error pin on the function list item or inside the editor pane? pin-on-list keeps the editor uncluttered. maya (design): pin-on-list is my preference — quick glance for invalid defs. clicking the pin expands a small inline inspector with the error messages. sam (eng): technically fine. small caveat: expanding inline inspector will fetch the latest schema linter results — add debounce (300ms) to avoid spamming linter on quick toggles. olivia (a11y): For screen readers, make sure the inline inspector has role="region" and an aria-label like "function validation". Also announce when errors appear with aria-live="polite". ethan (devex): noted — role/aria-live. Also proposing keyboard affordances: focused list item + Enter toggles inspector; Shift+Enter focuses first error link. maya (design): cool. For the compact tool-card in run history, UX idea: show the tool name, a one-line summary (first sentence) and a chevron. expand reveals full structured output with schema tabs (input/output/meta). anna (product): From product POV, we should surface token/cost delta for expanded tool runs (so PMs can spot expensive ops). Maybe a tiny cost chip in the compact card? ethan (devex): cost chip makes sense. Keep it subtle: 12px label, muted bg. Also need to support streaming partial outputs — compact card should show a live dot when streaming. sam (eng): Implementation note: storing full structured output for N recent runs will increase state. Suggest: keep compact store (summary + pointer) and lazy-load full output on expand. pointer = s3 path or internal id. maya (design): agreed. UX copy nit: replace "Args" with "Call arguments" in the compact card to reduce ambiguity. olivia (a11y): copy change ok. Also ensure that when the card expands, focus moves into the output container and there's a visible focus trap for keyboard users. ethan (devex): I'll sketch the ARIA flow: on expand, set focus to the first interactive element in the inspector, push a focus outline, and add a "Close" button with Esc binding. maya (design): mock updated with copy + focus flow. small code snippet for the inline inspector layout: ```
...
``` sam (eng): LGTM. add debounce and ensure the linter endpoint tolerates polling. anna (product): Sync decision: roll to beta users first, A/B 10% to measure number of expanded tool-cards and avg cost per run. if cost increases >8% roll back. maya (design): awesome. I'll attach updated frames and the copy list after lunch. deploy-bot: maya updated the playground mock: https://mock.redwood/playground/compact (deploy preview available) ethan (devex): follow-ups: I'll create a short RFC doc for the data contract (summary pointer + cost chip + streaming flag) and assign owners. tagging @sam for backend, @olivia for a11y sign-off. maya (design): thanks all! leaving action items in the thread: 1) ethan RFC, 2) sam debounce + pointer, 3) olivia a11y checklist, 4) anna metrics gates. :rocket:
